text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Hishi Akebono and I were 
called out to by Taiki Shuttle on the 
riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Akebono, howdy! Good timing! Could you 
lend me a hand, pleeeease?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Taiki-san~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, we are making a very, very big 
pizza for the shopping district event, 
YES! It's a pizza party for everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah! That looks fun! So, is that big ball 
the dough?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Now I'm gonna roll out that dough!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But... I can only make American pizza. 
American pizza has thick dough. Baking it 
in a pizza oven makes it rare...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's baked in a pizza oven! I can make 
thin Italian-style pizza~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wonderful!! Will you help me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can I go help out?
choice_data_list: I'll help out with you, too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay~!! In that case, let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, since we're at it, let's make 
Neapolitan pizza! Everyone, step back a 
little~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Woaaah!! A pizza just flew through the 
air!!

Hishi Akebono tossed the disc of pizza 
dough into the air, stretching it with 
centrifugal force. She then shaped it into 
a gigantic pizza base!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The sauce is spread, now let's arrange the 
toppings~!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's so big that my hands can't 
reach the middle...

By extending the brush handle, they 
managed to spread the tomato sauce all the 
way to the center. However, using the same 
method to neatly arrange the toppings 
proved impossible.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, it's my turn to shine! I'll show 
'em this cowgirl's special move!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey! Yee-haw!

Taiki Shuttle skillfully swung the rope 
tied to the bucket of ingredients, 
scattering them right onto the center of 
the dough.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: A lasso~!! Taiki-san, you're so cool~!!
choice_data_list: Only she could pull that off...
Only she could pull that off...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I'd love to let the kids 
arrange the toppings themselves~!"
choice_data_list:
If we throw it from higher up, it might 
reach.

If we're going Japanese style, it has to 
be ninjas.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
In that case, if we put the kids on our 
shoulders, it looks like we can pull it 
off~!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I threw it and it landed right in the 
center-!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Good job, good job! Can you fill in that 
gap over there too~?"

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Sis, go over there! There's a gap over 
there too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! After the toppings, please add 
cheese too!

And so... a massive pizza was complete! 
Everyone sliced off as much as they wanted 
and dug in.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
So delicious!! That's the tastiest thing 
I've ever eaten in my whole life!!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Father
text_block_list.text:
It's even tastier than the store-bought 
pizza! It looks great too—you did a 
wonderful job making it.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ehe! Papa, eat more! Seconds, please!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Please, have as many refills as you like! 
Oh! Why not invite your friends over too?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
You got it! I'll make sure those guys get 
a taste of the pizza I made too!
choice_data_list: It's a huge hit, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's all thanks to Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No, it's because everyone pitched in~. I 
don't think I could have made it taste 
like this all on my own.
choice_data_list:
The secret ingredient is everyone's 
feelings?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's why it tastes so good~! It's 
totally buono!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! I got Akebono's drum stamp!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Cooking together with everyone is so much 
fun~! Taiki-san, thanks for inviting me! 
Let's make something again!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah! A shuriken!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Let's all become ninjas! Shuriken 
swoosh-swoosh-swoosh!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
M-Mmh, it's so hard~! It's not flying far 
at all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Salami is easy to flick, but... veggies 
are impossible!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. Well then, how about we try 
throwing it like a sumo wrestler tossing 
salt?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: I don't watch sumo, so I have no ideaaa!!

After much trial and error, we somehow 
managed to finish a giant pizza, though 
the toppings are a bit sparse! Everyone 
cuts themselves a slice and digs in 
happily.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, the section I arranged has tons of 
salami on it!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"Look at mine! A flower! I made it into 
the shape of a flower~! Cooking is so much 
fun!"
choice_data_list: All's well that ends well, huh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It didn't turn out totally neat, but 
on the bright side, we can tell which 
ingredients we arranged ourselves~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad you've come to like 
cooking~!
choice_data_list: Huh? Is that on your plate...?
Huh? Is that on your plate...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you caught me. Yep, this is where 
Trainer lined them up~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even if you want it, I can't give it to 
you~. I had to beg Taiki-san to let me 
have it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just gonna eat it! Thanks for the 
fooood!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmm, BUONO!!!

Watching Hishi Akebono blissfully stuffing 
her cheeks with pizza, I felt like I 
understood a little better her desire to 
cook for others—
